title: Cardano House | RNC & DNC 2024 Policy & Education Centers (Awen)

ms.promise:
Project Plan Creation: Develop a comprehensive project plan, detailing the roadmap, timelines, and responsibilities for establishing blockchain education centers during the RNC and DNC events.
・A setup report detailing what we have learned about the physical setups of the RNC and DNC and how our events will run alongside each convention
・A roadmap of when we need to have key components in place: i.e. finding partnerships, developing educational materials, securing the venues, and coordinating speakers
・A list of key contributors and what their main responsibilities will be for the project roadmap
・A GitHub repository to store documentation
ms.criteria:
・The setup report, project roadmap, and list of key contributors should demonstrate that we have we have a reasonable plan for creating these events
・There is a GitHub repository created

ms.promise:
・Execute the planned educational events during the RNC in Milwaukee (July 15 - July 18) and the DNC in Chicago (August 19 - August 22), ensuring all logistical aspects run smoothly.
・Facilitate active participation and engagement with the Cardano and wider blockchain community during the events, providing opportunities for networking and knowledge-sharing.
・Implement post-event surveys to gather participant feedback, assess the impact of the education centers, and identify areas for improvement.
・Ensure comprehensive media coverage of the events, including interviews, press releases, and event documentation for wider visibility and future reference.
ms.criteria:
・Events occur at RNC and DNC as close to the plan as possible with the understanding that contingencies may arise.
・Members of the Cardano and wider blockchain community are able to engage with the events either in person or virtually.
・Launch survey to gather participant feedback.
・Events have documentation and media materials to provide visibility.
